positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Helping define the next generation platform architecture for the core Homes business.
* Led development and rollout of new server side rendering frontend architecture.
* Managed team that drove a core business metric from single digits to majority of bookings.
* Full stack feature development on search and checkout flow.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
* Technical founder responsible for all design and software development. 
* Built several iOS apps, websites, and server backends.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
* Sequence Supervisor on Toy Story 3. 
* Oversaw all aspects of effects production for several sequences including the final trash incinerator sequence. 
* Helped integrate a next-gen animation system for Brave and Monsters University.

positions.title: Sequence Supervisor
positions.description:
* Built brand new water simulation pipeline.
* Wrote custom software and plugins to 3rd party software.
* Oversaw finals shots for tiger in water sequence on 10,000 B.C.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description: Wrote custom software to solve the hardest technical challenges on several movies. Built a snow storm for Monsters Inc., developed the water simulation for Nemo, and led a team creating food for Ratatouille. I was responsible for projects from R&D all the way to final shots.
